scripts.text: No words for noob!! Level 40 below cannot join Singles Union Army!
scripts.translation: 菜鸟没资格说话！！等级低于40级不能加入单身联盟军！

scripts.text: ^ff0000You are overweight. Check your inventory and speak to me later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000负重过高。请整理物品栏后再来找我。^000000

scripts.text: - You can repeat this quest after 24 hours.
We need more materials to hold a Christmas party for the Singles Union Army!
scripts.translation: 我们需要更多材料，才能为单身联盟军举办圣诞派对！

scripts.text: Bring ^ff000010 Stolen Cookie, 10 Stolen Candy, and 10 Bag Of Selling Goods^000000 from those damn raccoons!
scripts.translation: 去从那些该死的浣熊那里抢回^ff000010个被偷窃的饼干、10个被偷窃的糖果和10个出售用商品袋^000000！

scripts.text: Did you kick the ass of the Raccoon Hooray team? Oh! You've brought all the items we need. We will be able to feel some Christmas mood with it!
scripts.translation: 你把浣熊欢呼队打败了吗？哦！你带齐了我们需要的东西。这样总算有点圣诞气氛了！

scripts.text: I will take ALL the items you brought. For that, I'll give you an exclusive reward only for Singles Union Army. You-must-open-it-ALONE!
scripts.translation: 我会收下你带来的全部物品。作为交换，我会给你一份单身联盟军专属奖励。你必须一个人打开！

scripts.text: Glory to the Singles Union Army! hihihi HAHAHAHA!!
scripts.translation: 荣耀属于单身联盟军！嘻嘻嘻，哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text: You have a total of {0} couple breaking points.
scripts.translation: 你目前共有{0}点拆散情侣积分。

scripts.text: Break up at least 5 couples and come back to me!
scripts.translation: 至少拆散5对情侣，再回来找我！

scripts.text: Yes! You did it!! More and more are joining the Singles Union Army!! hihihi HAHAHA-HAK! Victory is ours!!
scripts.translation: 太好了！你成功了！！加入单身联盟军的人越来越多了！！嘻嘻嘻，哈哈哈！胜利属于我们！！

scripts.text: BUT!!! While we're busy breaking up couples, those damn Raccoon Hooray brats stole most of our items. Without it, we cannot get the feel of Christmas mood.
scripts.translation: 但是！！！我们忙着拆散情侣时，那群可恶的浣熊欢呼队小鬼偷走了大部分物品。没有那些东西，就没有圣诞气氛了。

scripts.text: It's time to punish them and reclaim the items for the Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation: 是时候惩罚他们，为单身联盟军夺回物品了！！

scripts.text: ^ff0000>10 Stolen Cookie, 10 Stolen Candy and 10 Bag Of Selling Goods^000000 should be enough for the party. Find the raccoons on field maps and dungeons!
scripts.translation: ^ff0000>10个被偷窃的饼干、10个被偷窃的糖果和10袋出售用商品^000000应该就够办派对了。去原野地图和地下城找浣熊吧！

scripts.text: It doesn't matter if you brought more, I will take them ALL!!
scripts.translation: 多带也没关系，我会全部收下！！

scripts.text: Hey you!! Yes! You right there! You!!
You must be single. I've got a feeling. Right?!??
scripts.translation: 你一定是单身吧。我有这种感觉。对吧？！？？

scripts.text: Damn you! Taste the wrath of the Singles Union Army!!!
scripts.translation: 可恶！尝尝单身联盟军的怒火吧！！！

scripts.text: I knew it! First glance I can tell!
scripts.translation: 我就知道！一眼就看出来了！

scripts.text: Don't underestimate me, I've been single all my life! hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
scripts.translation: 别小看我，我可是单身了一辈子！嘻嘻嘻，哈哈哈哈——咳！

scripts.text: My name is Union Commander Cliff!
scripts.translation: 我就是联盟指挥官克里夫！

scripts.text: Anyway, this December, the day is coming....
scripts.translation: 总之，这个十二月，那一天就要到了...

scripts.text: Christmas songs everywhere, bright colored lights, pouring white snow, and couples seeing each other with smile on their faces...couples...COUPPPLEEES...!!!!
scripts.translation: 到处都在放圣诞歌曲，彩灯闪烁，白雪飘落，情侣们脸上挂着笑容...情侣...情——侣——...！！！！

scripts.text: In the beginning was a celebration of the birth of our Lord! Then, why...how...when did it became a day for couples??!
scripts.translation: 一开始，圣诞节是庆祝主诞生的日子！那么，为什么...怎么会...从什么时候起变成情侣的节日了？！

scripts.text: I will not forgive them for the happiness they bring only for themselves!!
scripts.translation: 只顾自己幸福的家伙，绝不原谅！！

scripts.text: No way! This Christmas will be a day for singles!!
scripts.translation: 没门！这个圣诞节将是单身者的节日！！

scripts.text: However, I will need members to stand against them. Its name would be, Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation: 不过，我需要成员和他们对抗。我们的名字就叫单身联盟军！！

scripts.text: What do you think? Would you join my Singles Union Army and make Christmas day for singles?
scripts.translation: 你觉得怎么样？你愿意加入我的单身联盟军，让圣诞节成为单身者的节日吗？

scripts.text: I can't say no, can I?
Yeah! That's it! but we need more members to stand against couples.
scripts.translation: 没错！就是这样！但我们还需要更多成员来对抗情侣。

scripts.text: Go find someone in Lutie and make them join us. 5 singles should be enough, now gogogo~!
scripts.translation: 去玩具工厂找些人加入我们。5名单身人士应该够了，快去快去~！

scripts.text: Go find 5 singles in Lutie and make them join!
scripts.translation: 去姜饼城找5个单身者，让他们加入！

scripts.text: Good job! I've met them all! They are worthy to join our cause hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!!
scripts.translation: 干得好！我已经见过他们了，个个都值得加入我们的事业！嘻嘻嘻，哈哈哈哈——咳！！

scripts.text: While you were gathering more Singles Union Army members, I've made badges..
scripts.translation: 在你招募更多单身联盟军成员的时候，我制作了徽章...

scripts.text: It might not be useful but this kind of small token can make our bonds solid and strong!
scripts.translation: 徽章也许没什么用，不过这种小信物能让我们更加团结！

scripts.text: Well, take this! Now you are the proud member of Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation: 拿着这个吧！现在你就是单身联盟军的一员了，值得骄傲！！

scripts.text: Now it is time to show our power to couples as we've got enough members!!
scripts.translation: 人手够了，是时候让那些情侣见识我们的力量！！

scripts.text: Go to Lutie and make couples separate. Doesn't matter how you do it, just them break up!!
scripts.translation: 去姜饼城拆散情侣，不管用什么办法，让他们分手就行！！

scripts.text: Well there is one more thing...
When you disturb couple, if they broke up, you will gain 2 point, in case of just simple argument will grant you 1 point.
scripts.translation: 你去打扰情侣时，如果他们分手了，就能得到2分；如果只是吵架，则得1分。

scripts.text: But if they become more into each others, your score will be minus 1 point. So when you got 5 points and come here for report, it means mission accomplished.
scripts.translation: 但如果他们感情更好了，你就会扣1分。所以拿到5分后回来报告，就算完成任务。

scripts.text: Surely you won't have minus score so don't worry.
scripts.translation: 放心吧，你的分数不会变成负数的。

scripts.text: Now it is time to show our power to couples as we've got enough troops!!
scripts.translation: 兵力够了，是时候让那些情侣见识我们的力量！！

scripts.text: Go to Lutie and make couples separated. Whatever they are just make them break up!!
scripts.translation: 去姜饼城拆散情侣，不管他们是什么人，让他们分手就行！！

scripts.text: Well there is one more thing...
When you disturb couple, if they broke up, you will gain 2 point, in case of just simple argument will grant you 1 point.
scripts.translation: 你去打扰情侣时，如果他们分手了，就能得到2分；如果只是吵架，则得1分。

scripts.text: But if they become more into each others, your score will be minus 1 point. So when you got 5 points and come here for report, it means mission accomplished.
scripts.translation: 但如果他们感情更好了，你就会扣1分。所以拿到5分后回来报告，就算完成任务。

scripts.text: Surely you won't have minus score so don't worry.
scripts.translation: 放心吧，你的分数不会变成负数的。

scripts.text: Haa.....breaking up right before Christmas....I'm alone...a single! ...AM I??!!
scripts.translation: 唉...偏偏在圣诞节前分手...我孤身一人...是单身！...真的是吗？？！！

scripts.text: Haa.....breaking up right before Christmas....I'm alone...a single! ...AM I??!!
scripts.translation: 唉...偏偏在圣诞节前分手...我孤身一人...是单身！...真的是吗？？！！

scripts.text: - Singles Union Army has come to you. -
err? Singles Union Army? What is that?
scripts.translation: 诶？单身联盟军？那是什么？

scripts.text: As I'm single! I'd never let couples enjoy this Christmas!!
scripts.translation: 既然我单身了，就绝不能让那些情侣开开心心地过圣诞节！！

scripts.text: I will join to the Singles Union Army!!
- Kwami has become a member of Singles Union Army. -
scripts.translation: - 夸米成为了单身联盟军的成员。 -

scripts.text: First of all, I've got to have revenge on my ex...No?
scripts.translation: 首先，我得找前任报仇...不行吗？

scripts.text: Hoooooo... it is so boring to play alone....
Hoooooo... it is so boring to play alone....
- Singles Union Army has come to you. -
Singles Union what? Why come to me?
scripts.translation: 单身联盟什么？找我干什么？

scripts.text: Break up couples and make Christmas party only for singles?
scripts.translation: 拆散情侣，再办个只有单身人士参加的圣诞派对？

scripts.text: That must be fun! I don't understand exactly but I will join, I'm in!!
scripts.translation: 肯定很好玩！虽然没完全听懂，不过算我一个！！

scripts.text: - Willer has become a member of Singles Union Army. -
scripts.translation: - 威勒成为了单身联盟军的成员。 -

scripts.text: Break up couples...this should be fun!!
scripts.translation: 让情侣分手...这听起来很有趣！！

scripts.text: Ewww! darn... what kind of friend would only boast about her boyfriend, disgusting! Does she really think that I can't have one?!?
scripts.translation: 呃...可恶...哪有朋友只会炫耀男朋友，真讨厌！她真以为我找不到男朋友吗？！

scripts.text: Ewww! Darn... what kind of friend would only boast about her boyfriend, disgusting! Does she really think that I can't have one?!?
scripts.translation: 呃...可恶...哪有朋友只会炫耀男朋友，真讨厌！她真以为我找不到男朋友吗？！

scripts.text: I can't... in fact, there is no one... I have no one!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation: 我不行...其实根本没人...我谁也没有！！！！！！！！！！

scripts.text: - Singles Union Army has come to you. -
You surprised me. What are you talking about, what is that?!
Is there room for another member?
- Rinka has become a member of Singles Union Army. -
scripts.translation: - 琳卡成为了单身联盟军的成员。 -

scripts.text: Wait for it~ my friend!! You will... join soon!!
scripts.translation: 等着瞧吧~ 我的朋友！！你很快...就会加入的！！

scripts.text: There is no one to bother you. No one to take care of. No more extra work from others. More time to spend it alone.
scripts.translation: 没人来烦你，也不用照顾谁。不必再替别人多做事，可以有更多时间独处。

scripts.text: Why are people giving up this advantage and want to be couples??
scripts.translation: 为什么有人非要放弃这些好处，跑去谈恋爱呢？？

scripts.text: - Singles Union Army has come to you. -
Yeah, I've heard of it recently. I knew that you would come to me.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我最近听说了。我就知道你会来找我。

scripts.text: No more words necessary. I will spread the advantage of being single!
scripts.translation: 不用多说了。我会把单身的好处传扬出去！

scripts.text: - Jee has become a member of Singles Union Army. -
scripts.translation: - 吉成为了单身联盟军的成员。 -

scripts.text: I will spread the advantage of being single!
scripts.translation: 我要让大家都知道单身有多好！

scripts.text: - Singles Union Army has come to you. -
- ...you may consider him to agree to join. -
- Marty has become a member of Singles Union Army. -
scripts.translation: - 马蒂已成为单身联盟军的一员。 -

scripts.text: - I cannot bear to see this!
- Run the machine to full power. -
Ding ding ding dong ding ding ding dong Ding ding ding dong ding ding ding dong
scripts.translation: 叮叮当当叮叮叮当当叮叮叮当当叮叮叮当当

scripts.text: Krrrrrrrrrr Dingding dong Krrrrrr Dingding Krrrrrrrrrrr ding Krrrrrrrrr
scripts.translation: 咔啦啦叮叮当，咔啦啦叮当，咔啦啦叮，咔啦啦

scripts.text: - I think I broke them both!
scripts.translation: - 我想我把他们两个都拆散了！

scripts.text: - I ran the machine for a while
scripts.translation: - 我让机器运行了一会儿

scripts.text: - But the sound of the machine
- Failed to break them, minus 1 point!
- After running the machine for a while
- I think I finally broke one of them!
scripts.translation: - 我想终于弄坏了其中一台！

scripts.text: - Here's 1 point for a good job!
- I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: It's my fault, I'm sorry. Please don't be mad.
scripts.translation: 是我的错，对不起。请别生气。

scripts.text: You're sorry? Do you know what you did? Do you have any idea why I'm mad?
scripts.translation: 对不起？你知道自己做了什么吗？知道我为什么生气吗？

scripts.text: It's my bad, I'm sorry. Please don't be mad
scripts.translation: 是我的错，对不起，别生气了。

scripts.text: You're sorry? Do you know what you did? Do you have any idea why I'm mad?
scripts.translation: 对不起？你知道自己做了什么吗？知道我为什么生气吗？

scripts.text: Well, I just feel like everything's my fault
scripts.translation: 我就是觉得，好像什么都是我的错。

scripts.text: You never know what you should apologize for!!
scripts.translation: 根本不知道自己该为什么道歉！！

scripts.text: Hey, what do you think I should say to my girlfriend?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你觉得我该对女朋友说什么？

scripts.text: - Tell her 'We should stop seeing each other'!
Maybe we.. should stop seeing each other?
Oh no, I just said it out loud!

What? What did you just say? We should stop seeing each other? How could you say that to me?! You're the one who's done everything wrong! Okay, you know what? Let's just break up! I'm sick of all this!
scripts.translation: 什么？你刚才说什么？我们别再见面了？你怎么能这么说？！明明错的人是你！好吧，你知道吗？我们分手吧！我受够了！

scripts.text: No, that's not what I... okay, that's it! I'm sick of this too, sick of you whining all the time! Let's just end this today!!
scripts.translation: 不，我不是那个意思...好吧，就这样！我也受够了，受够你整天抱怨！今天就做个了断！！

scripts.text: What? ...What did you just say? We should stop seeing each other?
scripts.translation: 什么？...你刚才说什么？我们要分手？

scripts.text: I can't believe you can be such a hot, tough guy! It's like I'm falling in love all over again!
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信，你竟然是个这么帅气、这么有男子气概的人！感觉我又重新爱上你了！

scripts.text: Honey, can you say that again, more in a rough way?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的，能不能再说一遍，语气再凶一点？

scripts.text: Huh? sure... Let's... let's just end this!!!
scripts.translation: 啊？好吧...那就...那就分手吧！！！

scripts.text: Hahahaha! You're awesome! Awesome! Say it again! Say it!
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈！太棒了！太棒了！再说一遍！快说！

scripts.text: Let's just break up! I'm leaving you!!

scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！耶！你最棒了！

scripts.text: What? ...What did you just say? We should stop seeing each other?
scripts.translation: 什么？...你刚才说什么？我们要分手？

scripts.text: ...I think we're both too upset now. Let's just talk about it later...
scripts.translation: ...我觉得我们现在都太激动了。还是改天再谈吧...

scripts.text: Hmm?... ah, yes, you're right... Goodbye, get home safely...
scripts.translation: 嗯？...啊，对，你说得对...再见，路上小心...

scripts.text: - Here's 1 point for ruining their date!
scripts.translation: - 破坏了他们的约会，获得1分！

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: Rinka. It's a huge mystery how such a pretty girl like you ended up in this Singles Union Army.
scripts.translation: 琳卡，你这么漂亮，怎么会加入单身联盟军？真让人想不通。

scripts.text: You think I'm pretty? hoho... It's mystery for me too, that a handsome man like you joined the Singles Union Army.
scripts.translation: 你觉得我漂亮？呵呵...我也很意外，像你这么帅的人竟然加入了单身联盟军。

scripts.text: Rinka. It's a huge mystery how such a pretty girl like you ended up in this Singles Union Army.
scripts.translation: 琳卡，你这么漂亮，怎么会加入单身联盟军？真让人想不通。

scripts.text: You think I'm pretty? hoho... It's mystery for me too, that a handsome man like you joined the Singles Union Army.
scripts.translation: 你觉得我漂亮？呵呵...我也很意外，像你这么帅的人竟然加入了单身联盟军。

scripts.text: Well, isn't it a shame we should spend Christmas alone? What do you say, Rinka, you and me...
scripts.translation: 一个人过圣诞节多可惜啊。琳卡，你觉得我们俩...

scripts.text: - To be a couple is to be a betrayer! You betray us, you die!!!
scripts.translation: - 成为情侣就是背叛！背叛我们的人，去死吧！！！

scripts.text: Isn't this the one who dragged us to the Singles Union Army?!
scripts.translation: 这不是把我们拉进单身联盟军的那个人吗？！

scripts.text: I just wanted to say we should find more members for the Club! Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation: 我只是想说，我们得给组织多招些成员！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: I'll see you later, Rinka. I am going out to hunt down more couples. Don't tell the boss!
scripts.translation: 琳卡，回头见。我出去再找些情侣来拆散。别告诉老大！

scripts.text: Hmm, I guess I should get going to. See you later Kwami, goodbye to you too~
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想我也该走了。回头见，夸米，还有你，再见啦~

scripts.text: - Successfully stopped a couple from forming!
scripts.translation: - 成功阻止两人成为情侣！

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: Actually, I have something to tell you.
scripts.translation: 其实，我有件事想告诉你。

scripts.text: It's very important so please listen carefully.
Biologically speaking, limbic system in the cerebrum enables us to be sociable, to communicate with people, to entertain etc.
scripts.translation: 从生物学角度来说，大脑中的边缘系统让我们能够社交、与人交流、享受娱乐等。

scripts.text: So when you see a beautiful woman, the information such as her appearance, her scent, the tone of her voice etc. goes to the limbic area.
scripts.translation: 所以，看到一位美丽的女性时，她的外貌、气味、语调等信息，都会传到大脑的边缘区域。

scripts.text: The limbic system then evaluates the information, to see if this lady is friendly, agressive, or charming, etc.
scripts.translation: 边缘系统接着会评估这些信息，判断她是友善、有攻击性，还是很有魅力。

scripts.text: When the evaluation is done, the limbic system immediately begins to secrete the chemicals.
scripts.translation: 评估完成后，边缘系统会立即开始分泌化学物质。

scripts.text: So if you're attracted to this lady, a hormone calls Dopamine is secreted and it makes you feel slightly happy.
scripts.translation: 如果你被这位女士吸引，就会分泌一种名为多巴胺的激素，让你感到微微快乐。

scripts.text: When that stage ends, you get the Adrenaline pumping, then you become more direct and enthusiastic.
scripts.translation: 这个阶段结束后，肾上腺素开始涌动，让你变得更直接、更热情。

scripts.text: I'm in that stage now towards you! In other word, I am very...!!
scripts.translation: 我现在对你就是这种感觉！换句话说，我非常...！！

scripts.text: Are you hungry now, Mr. Alchemist?
scripts.translation: 炼金术士先生，你现在饿了吗？

scripts.text: Ah.. yes.. I think I am...
There's a nice restaurant near here. Why don't you go there and have a meal?
scripts.translation: 附近有一家不错的餐厅。不如去那里吃顿饭吧？

scripts.text: ...Sure, thank you. Have a good day...
- Successfully stopped a couple from forming!
scripts.translation: - 成功阻止了一对情侣交往！

scripts.text: I see. I understand what you mean.
scripts.translation: 原来如此，我明白你的意思了。

scripts.text: Can I cook some nice meal for you, then?
scripts.translation: 那我给你做顿好吃的，好吗？

scripts.text: ...For the rest of my life, if you want...
scripts.translation: ...你愿意的话，我可以为你做一辈子...

scripts.text: - Failed to break up a couple
There's some food in the store, please come in.
scripts.translation: 店里有些食物，请进来吧。

scripts.text: - You did interrupt the couple in a way. Here's 1 point for you!
scripts.translation: - 多少也算搅和了这对情侣，获得1分！

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: So much beautiful white snow flakes.
So much beautiful white snow flakes.
But it's you who wanted to see the snow this Christmas.
scripts.translation: 可是，是你说这个圣诞节想看雪的呀。

scripts.text: Oh but I didn't know how much cold it is...oops...
scripts.translation: 但我没想到会这么冷嘛...哎呀...

scripts.text: Well, ok I see...Just come closer to me.
scripts.translation: 好啦，我知道了...靠我近一点。

scripts.text: What? I cannot hear you. What were you saying?
scripts.translation: 什么？我听不见。你刚才说什么？

scripts.text: ...Come closer to me. To my side.
- Hmm...there is no space at all
scripts.translation: - 嗯...根本没有插手的余地

scripts.text: ....But it's still too cold! I don't want to be here any more.
scripts.translation: ...可是还是很冷！我不想待在这里了。

scripts.text: I want to go back to Eclage!
Oh? Hey...we finally just got here, but you will go back right now?
scripts.translation: 什么？我们好不容易才到，你现在就要回去？

scripts.text: - No sweat at all, but everything is going alright.
scripts.translation: - 一点都不费劲，一切顺利。

scripts.text: Oh! It's much warmer than before...hehe
scripts.translation: 哦！比刚才暖和多了...嘿嘿

scripts.text: D..don't be too close to me!
Why not? Who cares. Let's go to grab something yummy.
scripts.translation: 好啊，管它呢。我们去吃点好吃的吧。

scripts.text: You're too close too me! I, I can feel your..um..hey!
scripts.translation: 你靠我太近了！我，我能感觉到你的...呃...嘿！

scripts.text: - Oops, I was attacked by that couple even without doing anything.
scripts.translation: - 哎呀，什么都没做就被这对情侣攻击了。

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: Finally got you, huh? You are cheating on me until now and even made me chase after you? I'll kill you boy!
scripts.translation: 终于抓到你了，是吧？你一直背着我劈腿，还让我追你？我要宰了你，小子！

scripts.text: Ooohh... my wife is too violent. Ohh...it hurts!
scripts.translation: 噢...我的妻子太暴力了。噢...好痛！

scripts.text: Finally got you, huh? You are cheating on me until now and even made me chase after you? I'll kill you boy!
scripts.translation: 终于抓到你了，是吧？你一直背着我劈腿，还让我追你？我要宰了你，小子！

scripts.text: Ooohh... my wife is too violent. Ohh...it hurts!
scripts.translation: 噢...我的妻子太暴力了。噢...好痛！
汶巴拉、贝尔兹和查比玛坦...

scripts.text: Oooh... The girls of Umbala are here... They're waiting for me now....Arg! Don't touch me!
scripts.translation: 噢...汶巴拉的女孩们来了...她们现在正在等我...啊！别碰我！

scripts.text: Those girls never wanted to see you and that's just a lie that they would come here!!
scripts.translation: 那些女孩根本不想见你，说她们会来这里都是骗你的！！

scripts.text: Umm...yeah I know..Is it true those girls are here?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我知道..那些女孩真的在这里吗？

scripts.text: ...Oh I got a stomachache... Did I have something wrong... Darling, just a second. I'll be right back soon to go to the restroom! Just wait for a while here!
scripts.translation: ...哦，我肚子疼...是不是吃坏了什么...亲爱的，等一下。我去趟洗手间马上回来！你在这里等一会儿！

scripts.text: Hey you idiot! Stop right there! Stop! ...STOP!!!
scripts.translation: 你这个笨蛋！站住！停下！...停下！！！

scripts.text: - Well, things are quite easy. Got 1 score point!
Who's there? You want to be killed, too?
You still don't understand anything. Come here, I'm taking you back to Umbala!
scripts.translation: 你还是什么都不懂。过来，我带你回汶巴拉！

scripts.text: ARG! ....Arrrrrrrrg!! It hurts! Noooo!!! They're waiting for me!!!
scripts.translation: 啊！...啊啊啊！！好痛！不要啊！！！她们还在等我！！！

scripts.text: - Well, he just made it harder for himself. Got 1 score point!
scripts.translation: - 嗯，他这是自找麻烦，获得1分！

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。

scripts.text: Whahahahaha the world will turn into darkness soon and everyone will kneel down before me!!
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈哈哈！世界很快就会陷入黑暗，所有人都将在我面前跪下！！

scripts.text: My master. All worlds will follow your will.
scripts.translation: 我的主人。所有世界都将遵循您的意志。

scripts.text: Whahahahaha the world will turn into darkness soon and everyone will kneel down before me!!
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈哈哈！世界很快就会陷入黑暗，所有人都将在我面前跪下！！

scripts.text: My master. All worlds will follow your will.
scripts.translation: 我的主人。所有世界都将遵循您的意志。

scripts.text: You've been loyal to me even though I've been giving difficult orders. You deserve a reward. What do you want for now? I'll definitely make it for you. I can even give you more power!
scripts.translation: 尽管我总是下达艰难的命令，你仍然忠心耿耿。你应得一份奖赏。现在想要什么？我一定会满足你，甚至还能赐予你更多力量！

scripts.text: Could you really give me anything that I want...?
scripts.translation: 我想要什么，您真的都会给吗...？

scripts.text: I've been in love with you...
It's not that I didn't know about that.
scripts.translation: 我并不是不知道这件事。

scripts.text: ...But we're demons. Demons choosing a path towards love?! Ridiculous, the dark world will never forgive us! We will be hiding for the rest of our lives!
scripts.translation: ...可是我们是恶魔。恶魔竟然选择追求爱情？！太荒唐了，黑暗世界绝不会原谅我们！我们只好一辈子躲起来！

scripts.text: It doesn't matter as long as I am with you, my master...
scripts.translation: 只要能和您在一起，都没关系，主人...

scripts.text: - I'm sorry to bother you... but weren't you discussing about conquering the world?
scripts.translation: - 抱歉打扰一下...你们不是在讨论征服世界吗？

scripts.text: Ye..yes. That's right, succubus! We've already had such a high goal!
scripts.translation: 是...是的。没错，梦魔！我们的目标本来就很远大！

scripts.text: I appreciated the thought but know your place! Just be my subordinate as you already are.
scripts.translation: 我很感谢你的心意，但别忘了自己的身份！你只要继续做我的部下就好。

scripts.text: Oh yes...my master, please forgive me. I'll try my best to make your the world yours.
scripts.translation: 是的...主人，请原谅我。我会尽力让世界成为您的囊中之物。

scripts.text: Yes! There is nothing better than turning this world into darkness. Everyone will kneel down before me. Hahahahahahahahah!!!
scripts.translation: 没错！没有什么比让世界陷入黑暗更棒了。所有人都会跪在我面前。哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！

scripts.text: - I got a big success to break up a couple!
scripts.translation: - 我成功拆散了一对情侣！

scripts.text: Conquering the world... It's useless compared to what we've feeling right now.
scripts.translation: 征服世界...比起我们此刻的感情，根本不值一提。

scripts.text: Dear Succubus, can you really overcome any kind of agony if you are with me?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的梦魔，只要和我在一起，你真的什么痛苦都能承受吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I'm prepared and will keep going... I'll follow you forever even if I shall be in any kind of agony.
scripts.translation: 当然，我已经做好准备，会继续下去...无论承受怎样的痛苦，我都会永远追随您。

scripts.text: I see...I can feel your heart now. Ok, let's go together... no matter how hard it will be!!
scripts.translation: 我明白了...现在我能感受到你的心意。好，我们一起走下去...无论前路多么艰难！！

scripts.text: - I saved this world from darkess.
scripts.translation: - 我拯救了这个世界，使其免于黑暗。
- 可一对情侣却因此走到了一起！

scripts.text: - I should go back to Union Commander Cliff.
scripts.translation: - 我该回去找联盟指挥官克里夫了。
